corpus_arm_rule: base/neighbour: own arm; random: the draw whose judged stage-A leg retrieved the window (both: the first in corpus-arm order)
label_rule: answers if any registry's final label is answers; not if judged and none answers; else unjudged

measures.A: a chunk labelled answers for the record (any registry in the label table: control, cover-any, stage1b) is in the top 10
measures.A_from_other_pairs_only: A without A_own: the answers chunk was mapped for another pair of the same record
measures.A_or_unlabelled: A, or any unlabelled chunk in the top 10 (upper bound)
measures.A_own: one of this pair's own mapped chunks (max-overlap or cover-any) is labelled answers and in the top 10
measures.A_own_window_retained: A_own among the same pairs as M_window_retained
measures.M: the pair's max-overlap chunk is in the top 10 (rank bands beside)
measures.M_window_retained: M among the pairs whose stage-A window was in the same retriever's same-arm stage-A top 10
measures.U: top-10 chunks with no label for the record (unjudged or never judged)

definitions.A_vs_A_own: A counts any chunk labelled answers for the record, including chunks mapped for another pair of the same record; A_own only this pair's max-overlap and cover-any chunks
definitions.all_lost: every lost pair (control chunk judged not), whatever its cover-any class
definitions.base_windows: a base-paper window is always run in the base collection, even when its stage-A window was retrieved only in a larger arm's leg (less competition than in stage A; its same-arm stage-A reference is 0)
definitions.primary_only_note: the control registry judged the max-overlap chunk not, and the cover-any re-read answers on the same chunk; the combined label is answers, so A (and A_own) for these pairs rests on that conflicting re-read
